title: Dock Tab Bar Controls Right
description: Shared maximize control for tab stacks on the right; tabs grow from the left (not per active tab, not right-aligned tabs).
summary: Reordered mode dock tab bar so tabs grow from the left (justify-start, no ml-auto) and the shared maximize cap sits on the right after the canvas gap. Multi-tab chrome grid now places before/active/after tabs first, then gap, then controls; added right-side control cap border tokens and tests for placement and a single maximize button per stack.
